verses: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا

leads.title: Cain and Abel ↔ The sun: the soul's two inspirations and the she-camel of God
leads.summary: 1 correspondence read side by side: 1 shared wording.

evidence.text: Read side by side in both originals (alignments/hb-quran/08-hb-quran.yaml).
Shared motifs, rarest first: God proportioned the soul and inspired it with (knowledge of) its wickedness and its piety; who purifies it prospers (weight 6.3). Pair score 6.3.

Only in Cain and Abel: Murderer evades God's question about his brother's whereabouts; The earth opens its mouth to receive spilled blood; Rivalry between a farmer brother and a shepherd brother; Firstborn animals and their fat offered to God; Exile dwells in the land of Nod east of Eden; God puts a protective sign on a murderer so no one kills him; Murderer condemned to be a restless wanderer, the ground withholding its yield; Sin personified as a beast crouching at the door, desiring the man; What the earth does with the murdered brother: takes in his blood, or hides his corpse [divergence between the texts]; A brother kills his brother in the first murder [divergence between the texts]; Parents' words to God about the child he gave them [divergence between the texts]; The first murderer's lament after the deed [divergence between the texts]; and 8 more.

Only in The sun: the soul's two inspirations and the she-camel of God: Thamud's most wretched one rises; the messenger warns 'God's she-camel and her drinking'; they hamstring her and God crushes them; God spread out the earth as a carpet, cradle or bed (bisat, mihad, daha, sutihat, tahaha); List of destroyed peoples or hosts (e.g. 'Ad, Thamud, Pharaoh) recalled as warning; A series of oaths by natural phenomena (dawn, night, day, sun, moon, sky, earth, stars, winds) opens or punctuates a passage; Destruction follows the people's rejection of a messenger.

The sun: the soul's two inspirations and the she-camel of God: tagged by Claude (model), reading the Arabic.

matches.note: wa-nafsin wa-mā sawwāhā fa-alhamahā fujūrahā wa-taqwāhā, qad aflaḥa man zakkāhā wa-qad khāba man dassāhā ~ hă-lôʾ ʾim têṭîv śeʾēt we-ʾim lōʾ têṭîv la-ppetaḥ ḥaṭṭāʾt rōvēṣ ... we-ʾattāh timšol bô: the soul faces good and sin and must master it; in the Quran God himself inspires both, in Genesis sin crouches outside. cf. rabbinic yeṣer ha-ṭôv / yeṣer ha-raʿ (not a match).

passages.text: הֲל֤וֹא אִם תֵּיטִיב֙ שְׂאֵ֔ת וְאִם֙ לֹ֣א תֵיטִ֔יב לַפֶּ֖תַח חַטָּ֣את רֹבֵ֑ץ וְאֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ תְּשׁ֣וּקָת֔וֹ וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּמְשָׁל בּֽוֹ
